name: Agency Pending Payments Chart Report
query:
SELECT 
    CONCAT(LEFT(MONTHNAME(child.payment_due_date), 3), ' ', YEAR(child.payment_due_date)) AS "Month:Data:120",
    parent.pcc_code AS "PCC Code:Data:120",
    parent.agency_name AS "Agency Name:Link/Agency Contract:220",
    child.payment_no AS "Payment No:Data:120",
    child.payment_due_date AS "Due Date:Date:120",
    NULL AS "Payment Amount:Currency:120"
FROM 
    `tabAgency Contract Payment` child
INNER JOIN 
    `tabAgency Contract` parent ON child.parent = parent.name
WHERE 
    parent.docstatus < 2 
    AND child.paid = 0
    AND (COALESCE(%(year)s, '') = '' OR YEAR(child.payment_due_date) = %(year)s)
ORDER BY 
    child.payment_due_date ASC

--     child.payment_no AS "Payment No:Data:120",

--     NULL AS "Payment Amount:Currency:120"

--     `tabAgency Contract Payment` child
-- INNER JOIN 
--     `tabAgency Contract` parent ON child.parent = parent.name
-- WHERE 
--     parent.docstatus < 2 
--     AND child.paid = 0
-- ORDER BY 
--     child.payment_due_date ASC

-- SELECT 
--     DATE_FORMAT(child.payment_due_date, '%%b %%Y') AS "Month:Data:120",
--     COUNT(child.name) AS "Payments Count:Int:120"
-- FROM 
--     `tabAgency Contract Payment` child
-- INNER JOIN

-- WHERE 
--     parent.docstatus < 2 
--     AND child.paid = 0
-- GROUP BY 
--     DATE_FORMAT(child.payment_due_date, '%%Y-%%m')
-- ORDER BY

report_script: # 1. تعريف كافة أعمدة التقرير (تحويل نوع Payment Amount إلى Data لإضافة علامة $ والفواصل العشرية) columns = [ {"label": "Month/Year", "fieldname": "month", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 120}, {"label": "PCC Code", "fieldname": "pcc_code", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 120}, {"label": "Agency Name", "fieldname": "agency_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 200}, {"label": "Payment No", "fieldname": "payment_no", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 120}, {"label": "Cycle Due Date", "fieldname": "cycle_date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 130}, {"label": "Payment Date", "fieldname": "due_date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 120}, {"label": "Payment Amount", "fieldname": "payment_amount", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 130}, {"label": "Paid/UnPaid", "fieldname": "status", "fieldtype": "Check", "width": 100}, {"label": "Message", "fieldname": "message", "fieldtype": "Small Text", "width": 200} ] # 2. الاستعلام لجلب البيانات من الجدول الفرعي والعقد الرئيسي raw_query = """ SELECT child.payment_due_date, child.cycle_date, child.payment_amount, child.message, child.payment_no, child.paid, parent.name AS agency_contract_name, parent.pcc_code, parent.agency_name FROM `tabAgency Contract Payment` child INNER JOIN `tabAgency Contract` parent ON child.parent = parent.name WHERE parent.docstatus < 2 ORDER BY child.payment_due_date ASC """ raw_data = frappe.db.sql(raw_query, as_dict=True) # 3. قراءة الفلاتر if not filters: filters = {} year_filter = filters.get("year") month_filter = filters.get("month") paid_filter = filters.get("status") or "All" month_map = { "january": 1, "jan": 1, "february": 2, "feb": 2, "march": 3, "mar": 3, "april": 4, "apr": 4, "may": 5, "june": 6, "jun": 6, "july": 7, "jul": 7, "august": 8, "aug": 8, "september": 9, "sep": 9, "october": 10, "oct": 10, "november": 11, "nov": 11, "december": 12, "dec": 12 } target_month_num = None if month_filter and str(month_filter).strip().lower() != "all": target_month_num = month_map.get(str(month_filter).strip().lower()) # 4. معالجة وتصفية البيانات final_rows = [] total_payment = 0.0 months_short = ["", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"] for r in raw_data: due_date = r.get("payment_due_date") if not due_date: continue if isinstance(due_date, str): year_val = int(due_date.split("-")[0]) month_val = int(due_date.split("-")[1]) else: year_val = due_date.year month_val = due_date.month # تطبيق الفلاتر if year_filter and str(year_val) != str(year_filter): continue if target_month_num is not None and month_val != target_month_num: continue is_paid_db = r.get("paid") if paid_filter == "Unpaid" and is_paid_db != 0: continue elif paid_filter == "Paid" and is_paid_db != 1: continue month_name = months_short[month_val] if 1 <= month_val <= 12 else "" month_str = f"{month_name} {year_val}" # تحويل مبلغ الدفعة لرقم عشري وتجميع الإجمالي amt = r.get("payment_amount") payment_amount_val = float(amt) if amt is not None else 0.0 total_payment += payment_amount_val # ربط القيم بالصفوف النهائية وتنسيق مبلغ الدفعة بعلامة $ وفواصل عشرية final_rows.append({ "month": month_str, "pcc_code": r.get("pcc_code"), "agency_name": r.get("agency_name"), "payment_no": r.get("payment_no"), "cycle_date": r.get("cycle_date"), "due_date": due_date, "payment_amount": f"$ {payment_amount_val:,.2f}", "status": 1 if is_paid_db == 1 else 0, "message": r.get("message") }) # 5. إضافة صف الإجمالي في نهاية التقرير المفلتر (وتمرير None للـ status لمنع ظهور Checkbox) if final_rows: final_rows.append({ "month": "Total", "pcc_code": "", "agency_name": "", "payment_no": "", "cycle_date": "", "due_date": "", "payment_amount": f"$ {total_payment:,.2f}", "status": None, "message": "" }) data = columns, final_rows

report_script: # 1. تعريف الأعمدة (بالترتيب المطلوب) columns = [ {"label": "Payment Date", "fieldname": "payment_date", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 130}, {"label": "SC Code", "fieldname": "sc_code", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 100}, {"label": "Agency Name", "fieldname": "agency_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 200}, {"label": "Account Manager", "fieldname": "account_manager", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "User", "width": 160}, {"label": "Measure Period", "fieldname": "measure_period", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 220}, {"label": "Required Data", "fieldname": "required_data", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 220}, {"label": "Payment Amount", "fieldname": "payment_amount", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140}, {"label": "Paid/UnPaid", "fieldname": "status", "fieldtype": "Check", "width": 100}, {"label": "Comments", "fieldname": "comments", "fieldtype": "Text", "width": 200}, {"label": "Market Share", "fieldname": "market_share", "fieldtype": "Percent", "width": 110}, {"label": "Account Manager Revision", "fieldname": "account_manager_revision", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 170}, {"label": "Ms Neveen Revision", "fieldname": "ms_neveen_revision", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 160}, {"label": "Customer Claim", "fieldname": "customer_claim", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140}, {"label": "Bank Transfer", "fieldname": "bank_transfer", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 130}, {"label": "Payment Tracking", "fieldname": "name", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Payment Tracking", "width": 150}, {"label": "Booking Measurement", "fieldname": "booking_measurement", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Booking Measurement", "width": 170}, {"label": "Agency Contract", "fieldname": "agency_contract", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Agency Contract", "width": 160}, ] # 6. صف الإجمالي (بدون روابط وبدون مربع اختيار) if final_rows: final_rows.append({ "name": "", "booking_measurement": "", "payment_date": "Total", "sc_code": "", "agency_contract": "", "agency_name": "", "account_manager": "", "measure_period": "", "required_data": "", "payment_amount": f"$ {total_payment:,.2f}", "comments": "", "market_share": "", "account_manager_revision": "", "ms_neveen_revision": "", "customer_claim": "", "bank_transfer": "", "status": None, }) data = columns, final_rows

query:
SELECT 
    CONCAT(LEFT(MONTHNAME(child.payment_due_date), 3), ' ', YEAR(child.payment_due_date)) AS "Month:Data:120",
    parent.pcc_code AS "PCC Code:Data:120",
    parent.agency_name AS "Agency Name:Link/Agency Contract:220",
    child.payment_no AS "Payment No:Data:120",
    child.payment_due_date AS "Due Date:Date:120",
    NULL AS "Payment Amount:Currency:120"
FROM 
    `tabAgency Contract Payment` child
INNER JOIN 
    `tabAgency Contract` parent ON child.parent = parent.name
WHERE 
    parent.docstatus < 2 
    AND child.paid = 0
    AND (COALESCE(%(year)s, '') = '' OR YEAR(child.payment_due_date) = %(year)s)
ORDER BY 
    child.payment_due_date ASC
